caption:
The video captures a white ceramic mug with a curved handle on its right side, resting on a wooden tabletop and strongly backlit by a bright window in an otherwise dim room. An open, angled book or tablet stand sits to the left, its cover catching the same backlight, while a pale plume of steam already rises from the mug's rim into the dim upper area.

Throughout, the steam continuously deforms and drifts upward, its height, thickness, and curl changing from moment to moment. At times it leans to one side, at others it forms a tall thin column or a broader billowing mass, partly overlapping the bright vertical window pane behind it, where the boundary between pale vapor and glowing background is hard to separate.

Meanwhile the mug, its handle, the angled stand, and the background window light all remain in place, and the framing shows no apparent pan, tilt, or zoom. The steaming is already in progress and continues without a visible start or finish.
relations: Hot liquid in the fixed mug feeds a continuous steam column rising above its rim.
Rising steam deforms and drifts upward, varying in height, thickness, and curl over time.
Strong backlight from the window makes pale vapor visible against the glowing pane.
The mug, handle, angled stand, and window light remain stationary with no camera pan or zoom.
